title: PostgreSQL Hybrid Search Query Questionnaire
concept: Hybrid full text and trigram search query

questions.prompt: Why does the hybrid query use both an FTS pass and a trigram pass?

options.label: They do the same work, so one pass exists only for syntax variety.
FTS handles exact lexeme matches while trigram search handles typo-tolerant candidates.
The combination avoids needing any database indexes.

questions.explanation: The two passes produce complementary candidate sets: precise lexical matches and fuzzy typo matches.
